title: Times table
description:
Read a number and print its times table from 1 to 10. For `7`:

```
7 x 1 = 7
7 x 2 = 14
7 x 3 = 21
```

...and so on to `7 x 10 = 70`. After the table, print the total of all ten answers:

```
Total: 385
```
hints: Loop `i` from 1 to 10. Inside, print one line with `n`, `" x "`, `i`, `" = "` and `n * i`, and add `n * i` to a total you started at 0 before the loop.
Print the total once, after the loop has finished.
